name: rifle
_note: Automatic rifle held with both hands (the left one supports the barrel in the sweep), so the melee weapon is put away while it is out. No fire clip yet: firing holds the aimed sweep pose (rifle_fire is clip-less - give it a clip when one exists). An empty magazine plays the reload clip (rifle_reload) on the whole body - it spins on its root bone; reloadTime matches it. Skinned to hand_r (no weapon bones): the muzzle is a point in hand_r space (model units, cm). The sweep aims from 90 deg up (first frame) to 90 deg down (last frame).
